## Problem and resulting behavior

Link the issue, explain the change, and state any compatibility impact.

## Validation

List focused checks and actual results, plus CI and unverified limitations.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Only synthetic fixtures; no health data, secrets or internal plans in the diff.
- [ ] Relevant tests/docs updated; offline, precision, isolation, immutable history and review contracts preserved.
- [ ] Third-party provenance and license terms checked where applicable.
- [ ] Independent review requested; no unrelated changes or rewritten commits.
